title: French toast
description: Thick slices of bread soaked in a cinnamon egg custard and pan-fried until golden.
instructions: Whisk the eggs, milk, sugar, cinnamon, vanilla, and salt in a shallow dish.
Melt a little butter in a pan over medium heat.
Dip each bread slice in the egg mixture for about 10 seconds per side.
Cook the slices for 2-3 minutes per side until golden brown, adding more butter as needed.
Serve hot with syrup, powdered sugar, or berries.
